entities.summary: The Palazzo del Capitano del Popolo is a historic building in Perugia, Italy, located in Piazza Giacomo Matteotti, within the Porta San Pietro district. It currently houses the Court of Appeal, the Office of the Attorney General, and various municipal offices.
